title: tACS for Patients with Post-Stroke Anomia
description: This dataset comprises EEG recordings from two individuals with chronic post-stroke anomia who underwent an 8-week individualized transcranial alternating current stimulation (tACS) intervention. Using a single-case ABAB experimental design, EEG was recorded during picture naming tasks across alternating stimulation and non-stimulation phases and at follow-up sessions. The study aims to determine whether tACS, guided by individual EEG profiles, improves naming accuracy and latency and whether these effects persist after intervention.
methods_description: EEG was recorded using a Starstim-32 system during picture naming tasks across multiple sessions (weeks 1, 2, 4, 6, 8, 12, and 20). tACS was applied during alternating two-week phases with frequency and montage personalized based on each participant's initial EEG profile. Data were preprocessed in EEGLAB and organized into BIDS format.
